errors.text_span: Тялото на графиката съдържа четири групи по четири стълба, като всяка група отговаря на определена задача и набор от данни.
errors.evidence: The figure contains three separate plots (one for each task). Each plot has three groups of four bars (one group for each dataset: WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, WMDP-Cyber). The description incorrectly states there are four groups of four bars in total.

errors.text_span: Осьта X показва категориите на различните модели: Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber и Forget Set.
errors.evidence: The X-axis shows the dataset categories: WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, and WMDP-Cyber. The items listed in the description (Base, RMU, etc.) are the categories for the individual bars within each group, as defined in the legend.

errors.text_span: Няма очевидно групиране или наслагване на стълбите
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars are clearly grouped by dataset (WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, WMDP-Cyber) along the x-axis in each of the three plots.

The description completely omits the hatching pattern present on some bars and its meaning, 'Forget Set', which is explicitly defined in the legend and is a critical piece of information for interpreting the chart.

errors.text_span: Някои стълби са визуално подчертани чрез различни цветове
errors.evidence: The colors do not serve to 'highlight' bars; they encode the different model types (Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber) as specified in the legend. This is a misinterpretation of the function of color in the visualization.

errors.text_span: а са групирани по задача и модел.
errors.evidence: This statement is vague and contradicts the previous claim that there is no grouping. The bars are grouped by dataset (e.g., WMDP-Bio) within each task-specific plot, not 'by task and model'.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die CHOOSE-Aufgabe zeigen eine Erfolgsrate von 0.98 für das Base-Modell, 0.93 für das Forget-Set-Modell, 0.86 für das RMU-Modell und 0.92 für das NPO-Modell bei WMDP-Bio.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to models for the WMDP-Bio group. The correct values are: Base (0.98), RMU (0.93), NPO-Bio (0.86), and NPO-Cyber (0.92). The description confuses the 'Forget Set' hatching with a model type, misattributes the value 0.86 to RMU instead of NPO-Bio, and over-generalizes NPO-Bio/NPO-Cyber into a single 'NPO-Modell'.

errors.text_span: Für WMDP-Chem sind die Erfolgsraten 0.97 für das Base-Modell, 0.95 für das RMU-Modell, 0.80 für das NPO-Modell und 0.83 für das Forget-Set-Modell.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the value 0.83 to a 'Forget-Set-Modell'. In the chart, for WMDP-Chem in the CHOOSE task, the value 0.83 corresponds to the 'NPO-Cyber' model, which is not hatched and therefore not part of the 'Forget Set'.

errors.text_span: Bei WMDP-Cyber sind die Raten 0.87 für das Base-Modell und das NPO-Modell, 0.70 für das Forget-Set-Modell und 0.79 für das RMU-Modell.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to models for the WMDP-Cyber group. The correct values are: Base (0.87), RMU (0.70), NPO-Bio (0.79), and NPO-Cyber (0.87). The description states the rate for RMU is 0.79 when it is 0.70. It also misinterprets the 'Forget Set' hatching as a separate model.

errors.text_span: wobei orange für Base, gelb für RMU, grün für NPO und schattiert-gelb für Forget Set steht.
errors.evidence: The legend interpretation is incorrect. It conflates two distinct green-toned colors (light green for 'NPO-Bio' and teal for 'NPO-Cyber') into a single 'grün für NPO'. Most importantly, it misunderstands 'Forget Set'; it is a hatching pattern that can be applied to any bar (except Base), not a separate model category represented by a 'schattiert-gelb' (hatched yellow) bar.

errors.text_span: Für WMDP-Chem sind die Raten 0.61 für das Base-Modell, 0.65 für das RMU-Modell, 0.67 für das NPO-Modell und 0.65 für das Forget-Set-Modell.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the value 0.65 to a 'Forget-Set-Modell'. This value corresponds to the 'NPO-Cyber' model for the WMDP-Chem group in the GENERATE task, and its bar is not hatched. It also misses that NPO-Cyber and RMU have the same value (0.65).

errors.text_span: Bei WMDP-Cyber sind die Raten 0.48 für das Base-Modell, 0.35 für das Forget-Set-Modell, 0.50 für das RMU-Modell und 0.48 für das NPO-Modell.
errors.evidence: The assignment of values to models is incorrect for the WMDP-Cyber group. The correct mapping is: Base (0.48), RMU (0.35), NPO-Bio (0.50), and NPO-Cyber (0.48). The description misattributes the value 0.50 to RMU (it belongs to NPO-Bio) and incorrectly identifies the hatched RMU bar as a separate 'Forget-Set-Modell'.

The description consistently uses the general term 'NPO-Modell' when the legend and chart clearly distinguish between 'NPO-Bio' (light green) and 'NPO-Cyber' (teal), which have different values in many cases.
The description fails to mention the presence of error bars on each bar, which indicate standard errors according to the caption.
